title: truth
description: The role a pre-bilattice value bears as an answer to which way the evidence points, independent of how much evidence there is - realized as an order ranking values by how supportive they are of the assertion. It is the first of the pre-bilattice's two lattice orders.

truth-order.description: the order <=_t ranking values by how much they favor the assertion; supplies the meet wedge_t and join vee_t of the first lattice

negatable.description: every value a has a counterpart ~a of opposite truth-position; negation is antitone in <=_t

transverse-to-knowledge.description: two values of equal evidence (one all-for, one all-against) are incomparable in knowledge but ordered in truth; the truth role is independent of and orthogonal to the knowledge role

extremes.description: when the truth lattice is bounded, its two named ends

designated.description: optional marked subset counting as truth-asserted; the standard Belnap choice {t, top} is the natural up-set in <=_t
